messages:
maria: starting a slow weighted probe for canary v3.2.2 -> green in eu-west1 at 02:15 UTC. initial weight 10%, quiet window 20m. posting release notes after we confirm.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: artifact redwood-service:v3.2.2 -> pool green (eu-west1). job_id=job-554b. preflight checks passed.
maria: Operational plan: shadowed traffic yesterday, now do 10% weighted shift with cookie pin for new HTTP sessions only. we'll monitor 1m/5m error_rate and p95, plus backend 502 rate. threshold: error_rate +0.8pp OR p95 +200ms OR backend_502_rate > 0.5% => abort.
josh: Who's running the router change? I can. Confirming perms for lbctl --force.
sre-oncall: I have perms and will lead watch. I'll watch oncall dashboard and be ready to escalate.
li: Note: we need to pre-emptively reduce max_conn on green to avoid connection storms. Doing that now.
deploy-bot: Router action applied: /opt/bin/lbctl set-weight --region eu-west1 --from blue --to green --weight 10 --pin cookie=green-v3.2.2. op=op-33a1
maria: Copying the ramp command we'll use if stable at 20m: 
```
/opt/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to green --weight 30 --grace-drain=90s --reason "canary ramp 30%"
```
josh: Are we draining streams? GRPC stream sessions are handled by connection affinity; we'll not forcibly terminate.
li: Also enabling short-circuit fallback on frontend to prefer cached reads during probe window.
deploy-bot: Metric probe (t+5m): error_rate 0.35% (baseline 0.2%), p95 260ms (baseline 230ms), backend_502_rate 0.05%. No automatic abort.
sre-oncall: All green so far. Continue to hold and observe for 20m. Paging rules set.
(20 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Metric probe (t+20m): error_rate 1.6% (baseline 0.2%), p95 480ms, backend_502_rate 0.9%. window=1m, region=eu-west1
li: 502 spike visible on service-db pool. Looks like connection saturation on green.
maria: Abort. Rolling back to blue now. Rollback cmd: 
```
/opt/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to blue --weight 100 --reason "abort canary: backend_502 spike"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback executed: traffic 100% -> blue. op_id=op-33b2.
deploy-bot: Incident auto-created: INC-2026-200. Links: https://tracker/redwood/inc/INC-2026-200
sre-oncall: Opening postmortem stub and collecting tcp dump + pool metrics for 02:00-02:25 UTC. Paging DB infra.
josh: For safety, temporarily set cookie pin to bluehold for new sessions and add a maintenance banner.
release-council: Noted for release notes: "v3.2.2 canary halted. Reverted to blue due to elevated 502s and latency. Green quarantined pending DB connection pool fix."
li: I'll push a revert branch with tuned pool settings and connection backoff. Target hotfix deploy to green tomorrow 03:30 UTC. Change request CHG-901 submitted.
maria: Good. Let's avoid permanent client pins. We'll keep blue active and mark green quarantine in release dashboard. Follow-ups: postmortem, changelog update, smaller 5% probe after hotfix. Closing thread unless pages escalate.
